description: Mechanical cross-check of the near-power edge lemma's contraction/lifting arithmetic, the cubic-vertex nontriangle-edge count, and the clean same-length merge lemma (contraction.md Parts I, III, IV).
scope_note: Tests only unconditional graph-theoretic mechanics on ordinary fixture graphs; does not and cannot test claims (contraction.md I.4 same-side-impossible, Part II) that presuppose a minimal Erdos-Gyarfas counterexample exists -- no such object is known.
note_on_python_version: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container (max available is 3.13); this run used 3.13.12 with an unpinned but current networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly). No other project dependency is required by this script.
fixtures: prism_with_diagonal (two triangles + matching, every cubic vertex in exactly one triangle)
30 random cubic-plus-extra-edge graphs, n in {8,10,12}, seeds 0..29
detector_agreement: Every lifted cycle validated by two independent implementations: a hand-rolled adjacency-list traversal (verify_cycle) and an independently constructed networkx.Graph traversal (verify_cycle_nx); 0 disagreements across all 35,357 lifts and all 4 clean-merge constructions.
completed_range: All 34 fixtures processed to completion (no partial/timeout runs); cycle enumeration bounded at length 9 per graph (nx.simple_cycles length_bound=9), not exhaustive to the graph order for the larger random fixtures -- this bound only limits HOW MANY mechanical instances are exercised, not the validity of any instance actually checked.
